title: Senate Intelligence SCIF meeting and Black Hawks over the investigator's house

tellings.quote: And boy, within a day or two of that meeting, the main investigator for Senate Intelligence had two Blackhawks over his house, unmarked,
and asked Jake, "Are you able to help me get security because somebody from the Defense Department is ordering helicopters to fly across and over my home. They're harassing my home."
tellings.difference: Relayed via Jake Barber, says the staffer asked Barber for security and blames someone in the Defense Department, dated 2024-2025 rather than c. 2022.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Senate Intelligence investigator/staffer having Black Hawk helicopters flown over his home as harassment.

as_told.title: Senate staffer harassed by Black Hawks over his home

plain: After a classified meeting with the Senate Intelligence Committee, its main investigator is said to have been harassed by military helicopters flying over his home. Steven Greer, an activist for UFO disclosure, says he took part in the meeting. It was held in a secure room for classified briefings, around 2022, in a period when Senator Marco Rubio was involved with the committee. Greer says that within a day or two, the investigator had "two Blackhawks over his house, unmarked." Ross Coulthart, an Australian journalist, tells it differently, through Jake Barber, a man who has come forward with UFO claims. In Coulthart's version, the staffer asked Barber to help with security because "somebody from the Defense Department is ordering helicopters" over his home. He places it in 2024 or 2025 rather than 2022. If true, it would mean parts of the military were intimidating the people investigating them.
